assessments.reasoning: The abstract and §2.1 of the author-hosted four-author paper identify TLA+ as a formal specification language based on untyped ZF sets, first-order logic and TLA, with modules and methods of combining them.

challenge.method: Read through the end of the §2.1 opening paragraph across the column break and compared §2.2's TLC identity and the separate original TLA manuscript.
challenge.results: Module composition belongs to TLA+ in addition to its logical base. TLC is a model checker for a subclass of specifications and does not set the extent of the specification language.

limitations: The statement concerns the full source specification language described by the paper, with original TLA and TLC separately scoped.
